requirements.quote: The Board may, in its discretion, waive the requirement for National Council of Architectural Registration Boards (NCARB) certified record if the qualifications, examination and licensing requirements of the state in which the applicant is licensed are substantially equivalent to those of this State and the applicant otherwise meets the requirements of this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: The commission of any fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in any professional relationship or in obtaining/maintaining license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of any fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in any professional relationship with clients or other persons; or with reference to obtaining or maintaining license, or with reference to qualifications, experience and past or present service.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or permitting an individual professional seal to be used by others, or representing oneself as the author of drawings prepared by others.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using or permitting an individual professional seal to be used by or for others, or otherwise representing registrant as the author of drawings or specifications other than those prepared personally by or under direct supervision of registrant.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using a professional license or registration that had been suspended or revoked.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using a professional license or registration from the Board that had been suspended or revoked.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct resulting in disciplinary action by a regulatory body of another state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct of the registrant resulting in the imposition of other disciplinary action by a regulatory body of another state for any cause other than failure to pay applicable fees.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Surrendered or did not renew a license after initiation of an investigation or proceeding.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Surrendered or did not renew a professional license or registration after the initiation of any investigation or proceeding by such body.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence, recklessness, or excessive errors or omissions in professional practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence, recklessness, or excessive errors or omissions or building failures in registrant's record of professional practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical disability or addiction that endangers public health, safety, and interest by impairing professional skill.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental or physical disability or addiction to alcohol or drugs so as to endanger health, safety and interest of the public by impairing skill and care in professional services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudged mentally incapable by a court of competent jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The registrant has been adjudged mentally incapable by a court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice architecture without a current license from the Board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice architecture or interior design without a current license or registration from this Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding or abetting others to evade or violate the provisions of this Chapter or health and safety laws.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding or abetting others to evade or violate the provisions of this Chapter, or the health and safety laws of this or other states

disciplinary_grounds.description: Undertaking activities or holding financial interests that compromise professional judgment in serving clients.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly undertaking any activity or having any significant financial or other interest, or accepting any compensation or reward except from registrant's clients, any of which would reasonably appear to compromise registrant's professional judgment in serving the best interest of clients or public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully violating the Chapter or any Board rule, or pleading guilty/nolo contendere to a felony or crime of moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully violating this Chapter or any rule or standard of conduct published by the Board, or pleading guilty or nolo contendere to a felony or any crime involving moral turpitude.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely impersonating a practitioner or practicing under an assumed or fictitious name.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsely impersonating a practitioner or former practitioner of a like or different name or practicing under an assumed or fictitious name.

definition_quote.value: Performing or offering to perform or holding oneself out as legally qualified to perform professional services in connection with the design, construction, enlargement or alteration of buildings, including consultations, investigations, evaluations, preliminary studies, the preparation of plans, specifications and contract documents, administration of construction contracts and related services or combination of services in connection with the design and construction of buildings, regardless of whether these services are performed in person or as the directing head of an office or organization.
definition_quote.quote: Performing or offering to perform or holding oneself out as legally qualified to perform professional services in connection with the design, construction, enlargement or alteration of buildings, including consultations, investigations, evaluations, preliminary studies, the preparation of plans, specifications and contract documents, administration of construction contracts and related services or combination of services in connection with the design and construction of buildings, regardless of whether these services are performed in person or as the directing head of an office or organization.
